ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The figure below is a map showing $12$ cities and $17$ roads connecting certain pairs of cities. Paula wishes to travel along exactly $13$ of those roads, starting at city $A$ and ending at city $L,$ without traveling along any portion of a road more than once. (Paula is allowed to visit a city more than once.)  How many different routes can Paula take?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are 12 city points, arranged in a rectangular grid of 4 columns and 3 rows. A is at the upper left corner, and L is at the lower right corner. The roads are the horizontal or vertical line segments between adjacent cities: each row has 3 horizontal roads, for a total of 9; each column has 2 vertical roads, for a total of 8, totaling 17 roads. Reasoning: Let the upper left corner A be coordinates (0,0), and the lower right corner L be (3,2). Paula must walk exactly 13 different roads, so this is equivalent to deleting 4 roads from the 17 roads, and the remaining 13 roads must be able to form an Euler trail from A to L. In such a 13-edge subgraph, only the degrees of A and L should be odd, and the degrees of the remaining cities should be even. In the complete 17-road grid, the cities with degree 3 are (1,0), (2,0), (0,1), (3,1), (1,2), (2,2). The degrees of A and L are both 2, even. Therefore the 4 deleted roads must exactly change the parity of A, L, and these 6 cities of degree 3, that is, the 4 deleted roads must form a matching covering these 8 cities. According to the adjacency relations in the figure, this matching is forced to be unique: delete A-(0,1), delete (1,0)-(2,0), delete (3,1)-L, delete (1,2)-(2,2). The structure formed by the remaining 13 roads is as follows: starting from A, one is first forced to go A-(1,0)-(1,1). At (1,1) there is a 4-edge cycle, which can be traversed clockwise or counterclockwise, giving 2 choices. Then one is forced to pass through the bridge to (2,1). At (2,1) there is another 4-edge cycle, also with 2 direction choices. Finally one is forced to go (2,1)-(2,2)-L. Therefore the total number of routes is 2×2=4.

method.method_draft: First read the image as a 4-by-3 rectangular grid of 12 city dots: A is the upper-left vertex and L is the lower-right vertex; roads are the 17 unit horizontal/vertical grid segments. Label vertices by coordinates (column,row), with A=(0,0), L=(3,2). From the text, Paula must use exactly 13 distinct roads, starting at A and ending at L. Treat the 13 used roads as a subgraph that must have an Euler trail from A to L, so in that used subgraph the only odd-degree vertices are A and L. In the full 17-road grid, the degree-3 vertices are (1,0),(2,0),(0,1),(3,1),(1,2),(2,2), while A and L have even degree. Since exactly 4 roads are omitted, the omitted roads must toggle parity at exactly A, L, and those six degree-3 vertices; hence the omitted roads must form a matching covering those eight vertices. Reading adjacencies from the grid, the only possible omitted matching is: A-(0,1), (1,0)-(2,0), (3,1)-L, and (1,2)-(2,2). The remaining 13-edge graph then has a forced initial path A-(1,0)-(1,1), a 4-cycle attached at (1,1), a bridge to (2,1), a 4-cycle attached at (2,1), and a forced final path (2,1)-(2,2)-L. Each 4-cycle can be traversed in either direction before crossing the next forced bridge, giving 2·2=4 routes.

图像描述：图中有 12 个城市点，排列成 4 列、3 行的矩形网格。A 在左上角，L 在右下角。道路就是相邻城市之间的水平或竖直线段：每一行有 3 条水平路，共 9 条；每一列有 2 条竖直路，共 8 条，总计 17 条。

推理：设左上角 A 为坐标 (0,0)，右下角 L 为 (3,2)。Paula 要走恰好 13 条不同道路，所以相当于从 17 条路中删去 4 条路，剩下的 13 条路必须能形成一条从 A 到 L 的欧拉道路。这样的 13 边子图中，只有 A 和 L 的度数应为奇数，其余城市度数应为偶数。

在完整的 17 条路网格中，度数为 3 的城市是 (1,0)、(2,0)、(0,1)、(3,1)、(1,2)、(2,2)。A 和 L 的度数都是 2，为偶数。因此删去的 4 条路必须正好改变 A、L 以及这 6 个度数为 3 的城市的奇偶性，也就是删去的 4 条路必须形成一个覆盖这 8 个城市的匹配。

根据图中的相邻关系，这个匹配被迫唯一：删去 A-(0,1)，删去 (1,0)-(2,0)，删去 (3,1)-L，删去 (1,2)-(2,2)。

剩下的 13 条路形成的结构如下：从 A 出发先被迫走 A-(1,0)-(1,1)。在 (1,1) 处有一个 4 边环，可以顺时针或逆时针走完，2 种选择。然后被迫经过桥到 (2,1)。在 (2,1) 处又有一个 4 边环，也有 2 种方向选择。最后被迫走 (2,1)-(2,2)-L。

因此路线总数为 2×2=4。

method.method_draft: First read the image as a graph with vertices (0,0) through (3,2), A=(0,0), L=(3,2), and edges between horizontally or vertically adjacent dots, giving 17 roads total. From the text, count ordered trails of length 13 from A to L with no repeated edge. Set up an edge-subset dynamic program: index the 17 roads from the image. Let dp[mask][v] be the number of ways to arrive at city v after using exactly the set mask of roads. Initialize dp[0][A]=1. For each state with fewer than 13 used roads, for each unused road incident to v that leads to w, add dp[mask][v] to dp[mask ∪ {road}][w]. After processing all masks of size 13, sum dp[mask][L] over all masks with 13 roads. This transition counts different ordered routes, not just different edge sets, because the current endpoint and sequence of choices are tracked. Evaluating this table on the grid adjacency read from the image gives 4.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有 12 个黑点，排成 4 列、3 行的矩形网格；道路只连接水平或竖直相邻的点。左上角标为 A，右下角标为 L。水平方向每行 3 条、共 9 条；竖直方向每列 2 条、共 8 条，所以共有 17 条道路。推理：按图把顶行从左到右记为 A,B,C,D；中行记为 E,F,G,H；底行记为 I,J,K,L。也就是 A=(0,0), L=(3,2)。按指定方法设 dp[mask][v] 为从 A 出发、已经使用道路集合 mask、当前在城市 v 的有序路线数，初始 dp[0][A]=1。若 |mask|<13，则从 v 沿任何一条未使用且与 v 相接的道路到 w，并把 dp[mask][v] 加到 dp[mask union {road}][w]。最后求所有 |mask|=13 的 dp[mask][L] 之和。这个 DP 记录了道路使用集合和当前端点，因此计数的是有序路线，且不会重复使用道路。为了核对 DP 的终端贡献：13 条被使用的道路意味着从 17 条中删去 4 条。完整网格中奇度点是 B,C,E,H,J,K；一条从 A 到 L 的欧拉式道路轨迹要求被使用子图的奇度点正好是 A,L。因此被删去的 4 条边必须把奇偶性改变在 A,B,C,E,H,J,K,L 这 8 个点上。由于只有 4 条删边，它们必须形成覆盖这 8 个点的匹配。由图中的相邻关系，唯一可能的删边集合是 AE, BC, HL, JK。于是 DP 中唯一有贡献的 13 边集合就是删去这四条后的集合。在这个集合中，开头被迫走 A-B-F，结尾被迫走 G-K-L。中间剩下左侧 4 环 F-E-I-J-F、桥 F-G、右侧 4 环 G-C-D-H-G。左侧 4 环可按两个方向走，右侧 4 环也可按两个方向走，所以共有 2×2=4 条路线。例如四条为 A-B-F-E-I-J-F-G-C-D-H-G-K-L，A-B-F-J-I-E-F-G-C-D-H-G-K-L，A-B-F-E-I-J-F-G-H-D-C-G-K-L，A-B-F-J-I-E-F-G-H-D-C-G-K-L。因此总数为 4。

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：图中有 12 个黑点，排成 4 列、3 行的矩形网格；道路只连接水平或竖直相邻的点。左上角标为 A，右下角标为 L。水平方向每行 3 条、共 9 条；竖直方向每列 2 条、共 8 条，所以共有 17 条道路。推理：按图把顶行从左到右记为 A,B,C,D；中行记为 E,F,G,H；底行记为 I,J,K,L。也就是 A=(0,0), L=(3,2)。按指定方法设 dp[mask][v] 为从 A 出发、已经使用道路集合 mask、当前在城市 v 的有序路线数，初始 dp[0][A]=1。若 |mask|<13，则从 v 沿任何一条未使用且与 v 相接的道路到 w，并把 dp[mask][v] 加到 dp[mask union {road}][w]。最后求所有 |mask|=13 的 dp[mask][L] 之和。这个 DP 记录了道路使用集合和当前端点，因此计数的是有序路线，且不会重复使用道路。为了核对 DP 的终端贡献：13 条被使用的道路意味着从 17 条中删去 4 条。完整网格中奇度点是 B,C,E,H,J,K；一条从 A 到 L 的欧拉式道路轨迹要求被使用子图的奇度点正好是 A,L。因此被删去的 4 条边必须把奇偶性改变在 A,B,C,E,H,J,K,L 这 8 个点上。由于只有 4 条删边，它们必须形成覆盖这 8 个点的匹配。由图中的相邻关系，唯一可能的删边集合是 AE, BC, HL, JK。于是 DP 中唯一有贡献的 13 边集合就是删去这四条后的集合。在这个集合中，开头被迫走 A-B-F，结尾被迫走 G-K-L。中间剩下左侧 4 环 F-E-I-J-F、桥 F-G、右侧 4 环 G-C-D-H-G。左侧 4 环可按两个方向走，右侧 4 环也可按两个方向走，所以共有 2×2=4 条路线。例如四条为 A-B-F-E-I-J-F-G-C-D-H-G-K-L，A-B-F-J-I-E-F-G-C-D-H-G-K-L，A-B-F-E-I-J-F-G-H-D-C-G-K-L，A-B-F-J-I-E-F-G-H-D-C-G-K-L。因此总数为 4。

raw_record.original_question: The figure below is a map showing $12$ cities and $17$ roads connecting certain pairs of cities. Paula wishes to travel along exactly $13$ of those roads, starting at city $A$ and ending at city $L,$ without traveling along any portion of a road more than once. (Paula is allowed to visit a city more than once.) How many different routes can Paula take?
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there are 12 city points, arranged in a rectangular grid of 4 columns and 3 rows. A is at the upper left corner, and L is at the lower right corner. The roads are the horizontal or vertical line segments between adjacent cities: each row has 3 horizontal roads, for a total of 9; each column has 2 vertical roads, for a total of 8, totaling 17 roads.

Reasoning: Let the upper left corner A be coordinates (0,0), and the lower right corner L be (3,2). Paula must walk exactly 13 different roads, so this is equivalent to deleting 4 roads from the 17 roads, and the remaining 13 roads must be able to form an Euler trail from A to L. In such a 13-edge subgraph, only the degrees of A and L should be odd, and the degrees of the remaining cities should be even.

In the complete 17-road grid, the cities with degree 3 are (1,0), (2,0), (0,1), (3,1), (1,2), (2,2). The degrees of A and L are both 2, even. Therefore the 4 deleted roads must exactly change the parity of A, L, and these 6 cities of degree 3, that is, the 4 deleted roads must form a matching covering these 8 cities.

According to the adjacency relations in the figure, this matching is forced to be unique: delete A-(0,1), delete (1,0)-(2,0), delete (3,1)-L, delete (1,2)-(2,2).

The structure formed by the remaining 13 roads is as follows: starting from A, one is first forced to go A-(1,0)-(1,1). At (1,1) there is a 4-edge cycle, which can be traversed clockwise or counterclockwise, giving 2 choices. Then one is forced to pass through the bridge to (2,1). At (2,1) there is another 4-edge cycle, also with 2 direction choices. Finally one is forced to go (2,1)-(2,2)-L.

Therefore the total number of routes is 2×2=4.
